product.title: First harvest EVOO 500 ml
product.body_html:
Cold-pressed within hours of picking from our century-old Chemlali trees in Djerba. Peppery, green and bright.

Olives are hand-picked in early November and pressed the same day at 24°C. Each bottle is numbered. Best raw: on bread, salads and grilled fish.

  • Cold-pressed
  • First harvest
  • Numbered bottles
  • 0.2% acidity

Produit de Tunisie — 100% naturelle.
